svg.title: Fig 14 — Pin map and wiring
svg.text: micro:bit V2 seated in robot:bit V2 — 7 of 8 breakout pins used (P12 spare); RC522 and HX711 on 3.3 V, servos S1–S3 on the robot:bit VM rail.
BREAKOUT HEADER (GVS) · 7 pins used, P12 spare
SPARE · V2 accessibility pin — verify before use
DC IN 5 V → servo rail VM (servo V+)
PCA9685 ch 8–15 → ports S1–S8 · S1–S3 used, S4–S8 spare
Internal pull-up · LOW = hatch closed (lever pressed)
HIGH = hatch open or broken wire → treated as OPEN (fail-safe)
Never route audio to P0 — alerts use the speaker only
Keep the clock HIGH ≤ 50 µs per pulse
E+ red · E− black · A− white · A+ green
Servo V+ (red) = robot:bit VM rail: 5 V from DC IN (3.7 V on 18650 backup). S1–S8 = PCA9685 ch 8–15. ONE servo MOVING at a time (S1 holds while S2 moves); then PWM off.
servo lead: brown G · red V+ · orange S
Pin table — micro:bit V2 via robot:bit (7 used, 1 spare)

g.text: Idle LOW; HIGH ≤ 50 µs per pulse
